requires: An M-VAVE FM-1 running stock V15 or official fm1_open firmware. If it runs stock V15, this page installs official Open first
Chrome or Edge on a computer, with MIDI and SysEx allowed
Anything you want to keep backed up. On official Open, M-VAVE's workbench backs up projects, samples and voices. Stock V15 has no project library for it to read

notes: CLATTER Pocket 1.0. The firmware is 0.9.4's, with a plain version number and its own identity, FM-1_8133700, so The Firmware Hub and installers can tell it from official Open. Installing it over Open or an earlier CLATTER Pocket, and leaving it for official firmware, work as before.

0.9.4 is verified on one FM-1: installed from V15 and over other firmware, patterns cleared and copied, its kits played, left for V15 and installed again. The report: https://github.com/clickysteve/clatter-pocket/issues/1. 1.0's own identity is being checked on the same unit before it is marked verified.
On PATTERN, hold SEQ and press REC to clear the pattern; SAVE+OCT− undoes it. Hold SEQ with OCT− to copy a page and OCT+ to paste it.
Untested on a device: Bluetooth MIDI and audio, DIN and TRS MIDI, SAFE MODE, and runs longer than a test session.
If an FM-1 is restarting at the start-up screen: power on holding HOME until SAFE MODE shows, then connect the installer. This has not been tried on a device.
